author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a stick figure (T-shaped shoulder bar and a single leg line) with a small box, not the reference's outlined figure; redrawn as an outline bust figure: round head 8 above a flat shoulder line with rounded shoulders, open torso sides, one arm raised high to the upper left, and a wide briefcase in front of the lower right.
omissions: Arm drawn as a single stroke; briefcase handle and the hanging forearm merged into the torso side meeting the case.
